notes.title: Update Notice - December 14, 2024
notes.content:
【Update Announcement】
We have applied a patch to our game! Please check out the following updates:

Difficulty Adjustment for Stage 2
Based on player feedback, we have adjusted the difficulty of Stage 2 to make it more enjoyable for everyone.

Bug Fix in Stage 3
Fixed an issue where some objects were unintentionally misplaced. Gameplay should now be smoother.

Object Adjustment in Stage 4
Adjusted the speed of certain objects in Stage 4 to improve game balance.

Improvement to Sound Mode
Added missing objects to the Sound Mode, enhancing your auditory experience. Be sure to use headphones or earphones for full immersion!
